description:
Business Development Representative

Growth · Remote (US or Canada) · Full-time · Reports to the CEO

About Nest

Nest helps veterinary practices offer care plans, monthly memberships that cover a pet's preventive care. Independent practices launch with no software fee and offer plans tailored to each patient. Nest connects to the practice's management software and handles what sits underneath: enrollment, recurring billing, payment collection, analytics, and marketing. Large veterinary groups run their memberships on Nest too.

Care plans change how pets receive care. Pet owners pay a predictable monthly amount, visit more often, and catch problems earlier. Hospitals build steadier revenue and longer client relationships. Our mission is to make that kind of preventive care available to every pet.

About the team

Nest's Growth team connects veterinary practices with solutions that make preventive care more accessible and easier to manage. We work directly with hospital owners, practice managers, and veterinary professionals to introduce Nest and help them understand how care plans can benefit their businesses.

We're a small, collaborative team that values strong communication, consistency, and building meaningful relationships. As one of our first BDRs, you'll work directly with our CEO, and what you learn on the phones will shape the playbook every future BDR uses.

What you'll do

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you'll be one of the first points of contact between Nest and prospective veterinary practices.

Your primary responsibility will be making about 100 outbound cold calls each day to connect with veterinary practice decision-makers, introduce Nest, and schedule qualified demos for our sales team.

We're looking for someone who enjoys talking to people, is comfortable picking up the phone, and knows how to make a great first impression. Experience in hospitality, customer service, or other relationship-focused roles can be a strong foundation for success.

This is an entry-level sales role with a path up. You'll build your communication and business development skills, and BDRs who consistently hit their numbers can move into account executive roles as Nest grows.

Responsibilities

  • Make about 100 outbound cold calls a day to independent veterinary practices to introduce Nest and generate interest in our care plan platform.

  • Connect with practice owners, office managers, and other decision-makers to identify opportunities and schedule qualified demos.

  • Clearly and confidently communicate Nest's value proposition during introductory conversations.

  • Follow up with prospective customers through phone calls and email to encourage demo bookings.

  • Maintain accurate records of outreach activity, prospect conversations, and scheduled meetings in our CRM.

  • Coordinate with the Growth team to ensure a smooth handoff of qualified prospects.

  • Reach 8 qualified demos held a week by your third month while maintaining a professional, friendly approach to every interaction.

Your first 90 days

  • Day 30: You've finished Nest training, know our care plans inside out, and reach 4 qualified demos held a week.

  • Day 60: You run full call blocks on your own and reach 6 qualified demos held a week.

  • Day 90: You're at full pace with 8 qualified demos held a week and help shape the script for the BDRs who join after you.

Who you are

We are looking for someone who is personable, motivated, and comfortable starting conversations with new people. If you meet the minimum requirements, we encourage you to apply. Preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • Previous experience with cold calling, outbound sales, or phone-based customer outreach.

  • Experience in hospitality, customer service, sales, or another customer-facing role.

  • Strong verbal communication skills and the ability to build rapport quickly.

  • Comfortable making about 100 outbound calls a day and handling rejection professionally.

  • Experience using a CRM to track customer interactions, follow-ups, and outreach activity.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Self-motivated, dependable, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

  • A positive attitude, willingness to learn, and real enjoyment of connecting with people.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience using HubSpot CRM.

  • Previous experience as a Business Development Representative (BDR), Sales Development Representative (SDR), or appointment setter.

  • Experience scheduling sales demonstrations or introductory meetings.

  • Background in veterinary services, healthcare, or other service-based industries.

  • Experience working in a startup or fast-growing company.

How we work

Nest is a small, fully remote team. Each person owns outcomes the company depends on, and the scope of most roles grows as the company does. We write decisions down, give direct feedback, and expect problems to be raised early. The work is demanding because hospitals and pet owners rely on it every day, and it suits people who want more ownership than a larger company would offer.

Our hiring process

Our process includes a short call with our recruiter, a recorded role-play you complete at home, a conversation with the hiring manager, a live mock cold call based on the actual job, and conversations with the people you would work with most. We will tell you what each stage covers before it starts, and we close the loop with everyone we interview.

Equal opportunity

Nest is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions based on the work and the person, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. If you need accommodation during the hiring process, email recruiting@nestveterinary.com.
